scope: These are explicit restrictions for synthetic coach-supplied scenarios. They are not clinical guidance or exclusions for every athlete with an injury. An injury label selects a scenario contract; it does not establish a medical rule. This audit covers prescribed exercise blocks. Warmup text has no ID, movement_family, or pattern metadata.

shoulder.constraint: Exclude the reviewed overhead press, landmine press, vertical pull, and overhead slam exercise IDs.
shoulder.notes: The library labels military presses and Push-up as movement_family=general and pattern=push. These fields cannot identify overhead movements. The shoulder profile therefore uses this explicit reviewed ID list. No scorer check reads name substrings. This is a metadata limitation and a deviation from metadata-only selection.

elbow.constraint: Exclude every prescribed exercise with the push or pull pattern.

knee.constraint: Exclude every prescribed exercise with the squat or knee_extension pattern.

back.constraint: Exclude every prescribed exercise with the hinge pattern or deadlift movement family.

hip.constraint: Exclude every prescribed exercise with the hip_flexion or lateral pattern.
